senses.en: (formal) together with this letter or document

example.en: Please find herewith the documents you requested.
example.zh: 随函附上您所需文件，请查收。

senses.en: badly or abnormally formed

example.en: The X-ray showed a malformed bone in his foot.
example.zh: X光片显示他脚上有一块畸形的骨头。

senses.en: the state of land being unable to produce plants

example.en: The barrenness of the plain made farming impossible.
example.zh: 平原的贫瘠使耕作无法进行。

senses.en: the inability to have children; infertility

example.en: In earlier times barrenness was often blamed only on the wife.
example.zh: 在早先，不育往往只归咎于妻子。

senses.en: lack of ideas or interest; emptiness

example.en: The critic noted the barrenness of the novel's style.
example.zh: 评论家指出这部小说文风的贫乏。

senses.en: a dated term, often considered offensive, for a cleft in the upper lip present from birth; now called a cleft lip
senses.zh: （旧称，常被认为具有冒犯性）唇裂；旧称“兔唇”

example.en: The old text uses harelip; the modern medical term is cleft lip.
example.zh: 旧文中使用 harelip 一词；现代医学术语是唇裂。

senses.en: easy to recognize or identify

example.en: The tower is a recognizable landmark in the city.
example.zh: 这座塔是该市一个易于辨认的地标。

senses.en: a mark, pattern, or color on an animal's body

example.en: This snake has distinctive markings along its back.
example.zh: 这条蛇背部有独特的斑纹。

senses.en: a written symbol or note made on something

example.en: The markings on the road show where to stop.
example.zh: 路上的标记显示在哪里停车。

senses.en: the act of correcting or grading work (British English)

example.en: I have a lot of marking to do this weekend.
example.zh: 这个周末我有很多批改工作要做。

senses.en: a person who studies history and writes about it

example.en: The historian spent years studying ancient trade routes.
example.zh: 这位历史学家花了多年时间研究古代贸易路线。

senses.en: a ceremony held after someone dies, when the person is buried or cremated

example.en: Many friends attended the funeral to support the family.
example.zh: 许多朋友参加了葬礼，以支持这家人。

senses.en: a clear, transparent mineral, especially quartz

example.en: She wore a necklace with a small crystal.
example.zh: 她戴着一条镶有小水晶的项链。

senses.en: a solid in which atoms are arranged in a regular repeating pattern
senses.zh: 晶体（原子呈规则重复排列的固体）

example.en: Salt forms crystals when the water evaporates.
example.zh: 水蒸发时，盐会形成晶体。

senses.en: high-quality glass, or objects made from it

example.en: The glasses are made of crystal.
example.zh: 这些玻璃杯由水晶玻璃制成。

senses.en: producing a lot; achieving good results

example.en: She had a productive day and finished the report early.
example.zh: 她度过了富有成效的一天，提前完成了报告。

senses.en: producing goods, crops, or other things in large amounts

example.en: The farmland is very productive thanks to rich soil.
example.zh: 由于土壤肥沃，这片农田产量很高。

senses.en: to say that someone has done something wrong or illegal

example.en: The company accused him of stealing confidential files.
example.zh: 公司指控他窃取机密文件。

senses.en: to blame someone for a fault or bad quality

example.en: She accused me of being unfair.
example.zh: 她指责我不公平。

senses.en: the group of actors in a play, film, or show

example.en: The cast came on stage for the final bow.
example.zh: 演员们上台谢幕。

senses.en: to throw or send something in a particular direction

example.en: She cast the ball across the yard.
example.zh: 她把球扔过院子。

senses.en: to shape hot liquid metal or another material by pouring it into a mold

example.en: The artist cast the statue in bronze.
example.zh: 艺术家用青铜浇铸了这座雕像。

senses.en: to create or present something, especially a problem, question, or danger
senses.zh: 造成或提出（问题、危险等）

example.en: The plan poses a threat to the local wildlife.
example.zh: 该计划对当地野生动物构成威胁。

senses.en: to stand or sit in a particular position for a photograph or artwork

example.en: The dancers posed for a group photo.
example.zh: 舞者们摆好姿势拍集体照。

senses.en: a particular position in which someone stands or sits, especially for a photo or artwork

example.en: The model held the pose while the artist sketched.
example.zh: 画家速写时，模特保持着这个姿势。

senses.en: the state of being clean or unmixed with other substances

example.en: The lab tests the purity of the drinking water.
example.zh: 实验室检测饮用水的纯度。

senses.en: the state of being morally clean or innocent

example.en: She maintained a reputation for purity throughout her life.
example.zh: 她一生都保持着纯洁的名声。

senses.en: slightly fat in a pleasant, attractive way

example.en: She has a plump baby with round cheeks.
example.zh: 她有一个脸颊圆胖的丰满宝宝。

senses.en: to drop or set down heavily and suddenly, often followed by down

example.en: He plumped down on the sofa and sighed.
example.zh: 他一屁股坐在沙发上，叹了口气。

senses.en: heavily and abruptly, straight down

example.en: The box fell plump onto the floor.
example.zh: 箱子扑通一声重重落在地板上。

senses.en: a confused twisted mass of threads, hair, etc.
senses.zh: 缠结的一团；乱糟糟的一堆

example.en: Her hair was full of tangles after the windy walk.
example.zh: 风中的散步之后，她的头发缠结成了一团。

senses.en: a confused or complicated situation

example.en: The two companies got into a legal tangle over the contract.
example.zh: 两家公司因合同陷入了法律纠纷。

senses.en: to become or make something twisted together in a confused mass

example.en: The strong wind tangled the fishing lines on the dock.
example.zh: 大风把码头上的钓线缠在了一起。

senses.en: to express something as a number or amount; to measure

example.en: It is hard to quantify the damage caused by the storm.
example.zh: 风暴造成的损失很难量化。

senses.en: safe or suitable to eat

example.en: These wild mushrooms are edible, but some similar ones are poisonous.
example.zh: 这些野生蘑菇可以食用，但一些相似的蘑菇有毒。

senses.en: an item of food, usually used in the plural

example.en: We packed a few edibles for the hike.
example.zh: 我们为远足带了一些食物。

senses.en: the best or most favorable amount, level, or condition possible

example.en: Exercise helps you reach your optimum of health.
example.zh: 锻炼有助于你达到健康最佳状态。

senses.en: best or most favorable; most effective under given conditions

example.en: The optimum temperature for this plant is around 25 degrees.
example.zh: 这种植物的最佳温度在25度左右。

senses.en: the crime of betraying one's country, such as helping its enemies

example.en: He was accused of treason for passing secrets to a foreign power.
example.zh: 他因向外国势力泄露机密而被指控犯有叛国罪。

senses.en: betrayal of a person, trust, or cause (literary use)

example.en: To her, his silence was an act of treason against their friendship.
example.zh: 在她看来，他的沉默是对他们友谊的背叛。

senses.en: giving an advantage; helpful or beneficial

example.en: The new location is advantageous for the company.
example.zh: 新位置对公司很有利。

senses.en: a round root vegetable with white or yellow flesh

example.en: She roasted turnips with carrots for dinner.
example.zh: 她晚餐用胡萝卜烤芜菁。

senses.en: in the form of a gas; relating to gas

example.en: Water vapor is the gaseous form of water.
example.zh: 水蒸气是水的气态形式。

senses.en: to publicly express support or approval for someone or something

example.en: Several famous athletes endorsed the new sports drink.
example.zh: 几位著名运动员为这款新运动饮料代言。

senses.en: to sign one's name on the back of a cheque or document

example.en: You must endorse the cheque before depositing it.
example.zh: 存入支票前，你必须在其背面签名。

senses.en: a list of employees and the salaries they are paid

example.en: She was added to the payroll last month.
example.zh: 她上个月被列入了工资名单。

senses.en: the total amount of money a company pays in wages

example.en: The company cut its payroll to save money.
example.zh: 公司削减工资总额以节省开支。

senses.en: an English family name

example.en: Joshua Reynolds was a famous English portrait painter.
example.zh: 约书亚·雷诺兹是英国著名的肖像画家。

senses.en: physically hurt

example.en: The injured players were taken to hospital.
example.zh: 受伤的球员被送去了医院。

senses.en: emotionally hurt or offended
senses.zh: 感情受伤害的，被触怒的

example.en: He looked injured by her harsh words.
example.zh: 她刻薄的话似乎伤害了他。

senses.en: feeling tired and uninterested because nothing is engaging

example.en: The children got bored during the long lecture.
example.zh: 孩子们在冗长的讲座中感到无聊。

senses.en: a claim or point asserted in an argument

example.en: My main contention is that the plan will save money.
example.zh: 我的主要论点是这项计划会省钱。

senses.en: strong disagreement or argument between people

example.en: The two sides have been in contention over the new rules for weeks.
example.zh: 双方就新规则已经争论了好几个星期。

senses.en: a person whose job is typing, especially on a typewriter or computer

example.en: The office hired a new typist to handle the reports.
example.zh: 办公室雇了一名新打字员来处理报告。

senses.en: the capital and largest city of England, on the River Thames

example.en: London is famous for its museums and historic buildings.
example.zh: 伦敦以其博物馆和历史建筑而闻名。

senses.en: Jack London (1876–1916), American writer known for novels about the Klondike gold rush
senses.zh: 伦敦（杰克·伦敦，美国作家）

example.en: I read a novel by Jack London last winter.
example.zh: 去年冬天我读了一本杰克·伦敦写的小说。

senses.en: a public road in a city or town, usually with buildings and sidewalks along it

example.en: They live on a quiet street near the park.
example.zh: 他们住在公园附近一条安静的街道上。

senses.en: the roadway where vehicles travel, as opposed to the sidewalk

example.en: Don't play in the street; it's dangerous.
example.zh: 不要在马路上玩耍，很危险。

senses.en: having the right to have or do something

example.en: All employees are entitled to paid annual leave.
example.zh: 所有员工都有权享受带薪年假。

senses.en: believing one deserves special treatment (often disapproving)
senses.zh: 自认为应享特权的；理所当然心态的

example.en: He acts entitled and never says thank you.
example.zh: 他一副理所当然的样子，从来不说谢谢。

senses.en: past tense and past participle of entitle: to give a title to a book or film

example.en: The author's latest novel is entitled 'Quiet Rivers'.
example.zh: 这位作者的最新小说名为《静静的河流》。

senses.en: an Asian water plant with large pink or white flowers, also called the sacred lotus

example.en: Lotus flowers bloom on the pond in summer.
example.zh: 夏天莲花在池塘上绽放。

senses.en: a sweet medicinal liquid; something believed to cure all problems or give long life
senses.zh: 酏剂，药水；万能药，灵丹妙药

example.en: The old legend told of an elixir of life.
example.zh: 古老的传说讲述了一种长生不老药。

senses.en: silicon dioxide (SiO2), found as quartz and sand; used in glassmaking

example.en: Silica is the main ingredient of glass.
example.zh: 硅石是玻璃的主要成分。

senses.en: a published notice of someone's death, often with a short life story

example.en: Her obituary appeared in the local newspaper.
example.zh: 她的讣告刊登在当地报纸上。

senses.en: the pleasant feeling of being with someone; friendly company

example.en: Pets provide companionship for many elderly people.
example.zh: 宠物为许多老年人提供陪伴。

senses.en: coming next after the tenth; 11th

example.en: She finished eleventh in the race.
example.zh: 她在比赛中得了第十一名。

senses.en: one of eleven equal parts

example.en: One eleventh of the total was donated.
example.zh: 总额的十一分之一被捐出。

senses.en: intense sorrow, especially caused by loss or disappointment

example.en: She felt deep heartbreak after the breakup.
example.zh: 分手后她感到深深的心碎。

senses.en: a drawing that shows roads, rivers, cities, or other features of an area

example.en: She checked the map before driving.
example.zh: 她开车前查看了地图。

senses.en: to make a map of an area or place

example.en: The team mapped the caves last summer.
example.zh: 团队去年夏天绘制了这些洞穴的地图。

senses.en: to plan or arrange something in detail

example.en: They mapped out a route to the airport.
example.zh: 他们规划了去机场的路线。

senses.en: a diagram that shows how parts of something are arranged

example.en: The report includes a map of the company's departments.
example.zh: 报告里有一张公司部门示意图。

senses.en: medical care given to a sick or injured person

example.en: She is receiving treatment for a broken arm.
example.zh: 她正在接受手臂骨折的治疗。

senses.en: the way you deal with or behave toward someone or something

example.en: The workers complained about unfair treatment.
example.zh: 工人们抱怨受到不公平对待。

senses.en: a process used to change or protect something

example.en: The water goes through a simple treatment process.
example.zh: 这些水要经过简单的处理过程。

senses.en: a gathering of people who have not seen each other for a long time

example.en: We had a family reunion last summer after ten years apart.
example.zh: 分开十年后，我们去年夏天举行了一次家庭团聚。

senses.en: the act of coming together again after being separated

example.en: The reunion of the two old friends was emotional.
example.zh: 两位老朋友的重聚令人动容。

senses.en: all the plants growing in an area

example.en: The island is covered with dense tropical vegetation.
example.zh: 这座岛覆盖着茂密的热带植被。

senses.en: (medical) an abnormal growth, especially on a heart valve

example.en: The ultrasound showed small vegetations on the heart valve.
example.zh: 超声检查显示心脏瓣膜上有小的赘生物。

senses.en: the scientific study of stars, planets, and other objects in space

example.en: She studies astronomy at the university and often observes the night sky with a telescope.
example.zh: 她在大学学习天文学，经常用望远镜观测夜空。

senses.en: a change in the shape or appearance of something so that it is no longer accurate

example.en: The heat caused a slight distortion in the plastic frame.
example.zh: 高温使塑料边框轻微变形。

senses.en: a false or misleading change of facts or meaning

example.en: The article presented a gross distortion of the facts.
example.zh: 这篇文章严重歪曲了事实。

senses.en: unwanted change in a sound or signal

example.en: The speakers produce clear sound with minimal distortion.
example.zh: 这些扬声器音质清晰，失真极小。

senses.en: legally responsible for something

example.en: The company was held liable for the damage.
example.zh: 这家公司被认定需为损害承担法律责任。

senses.en: likely to experience or do something, usually something unpleasant

example.en: The old bridge is liable to collapse under heavy loads.
example.zh: 这座旧桥在重载下可能会坍塌。

senses.en: subject to something such as a tax or penalty

example.en: The goods were liable to import duties.
example.zh: 这些货物须缴纳进口关税。

senses.en: to hold something firmly with your hand

example.en: She grasped the rope tightly.
example.zh: 她紧紧抓住绳子。

senses.en: to understand something

example.en: He quickly grasped the main idea of the lecture.
example.zh: 他很快领会了讲座的主旨。

senses.en: a firm hold with the hands

example.en: The child kept a firm grasp on his mother's hand.
example.zh: 孩子紧紧抓住妈妈的手。

senses.en: understanding or the limit of one's ability to understand

example.en: The problem is beyond my grasp.
example.zh: 这个问题超出了我的理解能力。

senses.en: sweet food eaten at the end of a meal

example.en: We had chocolate cake for dessert.
example.zh: 我们的餐后甜点是巧克力蛋糕。

senses.en: a country ruled by a king or queen

example.en: The United Kingdom is a kingdom with a long history.
example.zh: 英国是一个历史悠久的王国。

senses.en: a domain or sphere in which something is dominant

example.en: Physics belongs to the kingdom of science.
example.zh: 物理学属于科学领域。

senses.en: in biology, the highest category into which organisms are classified

example.en: In biology, mushrooms are classified in the fungi kingdom.
example.zh: 在生物学中，蘑菇被归类于真菌界。

senses.en: clean, tidy, and well organized

example.en: Her desk is always neat.
example.zh: 她的书桌总是很整洁。

senses.en: done with skill and precision

example.en: He gave a neat answer to the question.
example.zh: 他对这个问题给出了一个巧妙的回答。

senses.en: (of a drink) served without ice or water, used especially of spirits

example.en: He likes his whiskey neat.
example.zh: 他喜欢喝纯威士忌。

senses.en: something bought for less than its usual price

example.en: These shoes were a real bargain at half price.
example.zh: 这双鞋半价，真是划算。

senses.en: an agreement between people about what each will do

example.en: We made a bargain: I cook, and he washes the dishes.
example.zh: 我们达成了协议：我做饭，他洗碗。

senses.en: to discuss the price of something in order to reach an agreement

example.en: She bargained with the seller over the price of the rug.
example.zh: 她与卖主就地毯的价格讨价还价。

senses.en: a file sent along with an email or message

example.en: I opened the email and downloaded the attachment.
example.zh: 我打开邮件并下载了附件。

senses.en: a feeling of affection for someone or something

example.en: She has a deep attachment to her hometown.
example.zh: 她对家乡有着深深的依恋。

senses.en: a part or device that can be fastened to a machine

example.en: The mixer comes with several attachments.
example.zh: 这台搅拌机配有几个附件。

senses.en: a person who plays the piano

example.en: The pianist performed a beautiful concert last night.
example.zh: 这位钢琴家昨晚举办了一场精彩的音乐会。

senses.en: a plant with beautiful, often unusual-shaped flowers

example.en: She received a potted orchid for her birthday.
example.zh: 她生日时收到一盆兰花。

senses.en: a pale purple color

example.en: The dress came in orchid and white.
example.zh: 这款裙子有淡紫色和白色两种。

senses.en: wood from coniferous trees such as pine or fir; the term refers to the type of tree, not necessarily to how soft the wood is
senses.zh: 针叶树材（如松木、冷杉木；并非一定质软）

example.en: The furniture is made of softwood like pine.
example.zh: 这件家具由松木等针叶树材制成。

senses.en: to spend time socially with people, especially important ones
senses.zh: 过从甚密，（尤指与要人）交际来往

example.en: He loves hobnobbing with executives at industry events.
example.zh: 他喜欢在行业活动中与高管们交际应酬。

senses.en: low wet land covered with grass and reeds; a marsh

example.en: Herons nest in the fens where the water is shallow.
example.zh: 苍鹭在水浅的沼泽里筑巢。

senses.en: (in China) a unit of money worth one hundredth of a yuan

example.en: A bottle of water cost three yuan and five fen.
example.zh: 一瓶水花了三元五分。

senses.en: careful attention to watch for danger or problems

example.en: Constant vigilance is needed to prevent fraud.
example.zh: 防止欺诈需要时刻保持警惕。

senses.en: (of animals or plants) tamed and kept or grown by humans

example.en: Dogs were among the first domesticated animals.
example.zh: 狗是最早被驯养的动物之一。

senses.en: accustomed to and enjoying home life
senses.zh: 恋家的；喜欢家庭生活的

example.en: He has become quite domesticated since he got married.
example.zh: 结婚后他变得相当恋家了。

senses.en: to force or strongly motivate someone to do something

example.en: Hunger impelled him to look for food.
example.zh: 饥饿驱使他寻找食物。
